# onSSE bus — shared: onSSE setSSEQuery setSSEWatchdog setSSEReloadOnBuild closeSSEBus
# of shared/bus.js; it dispatches build-changed, and BC shows notice.js's "build" banner, as the
# Core hub does (sse.core-hub.txt). One page (shared/bus.js, as the
# operator station loads it), steps in order; a "second page" is a fresh one.

onSSE("order-update", A); onSSE("order-update", B); onSSE("connected", C); onSSE("disconnected", D) — before a microtask
    t=0 streams open before the microtask: 0
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=order-update
    #1 listens for: connected, heartbeat, order-update
onSSE("order-update", "not a function")
    t=0 returns a function
#1 ← connected {"build":"b1","seq":5}
    t=0 handler C({"build":"b1","seq":5}, <event>)
#1 ← order-update {"id":1} id 6
    t=0 handler A({"id":1}, <event>)
    t=0 handler B({"id":1}, <event>)
#1 ← order-update "not json"
    t=0 console.error onSSE parse order-update SyntaxError
onSSE("order-update", T that throws) then #1 ← order-update {"id":2}, then T unsubscribed
    t=0 handler A({"id":2}, <event>)
    t=0 handler B({"id":2}, <event>)
    t=0 console.error onSSE handler order-update Error
onSSE("bins", E) after the stream is up
    t=0 close #1
    t=0 open #2 /events?topics=bins%2Corder-update
A unsubscribed (offA())
    (nothing)
#2 ← connected {"build":"b1","seq":10}; ← order-update {"id":3}
    t=0 handler C({"build":"b1","seq":10}, <event>)
    t=0 handler B({"id":3}, <event>)
onSSE("stream-gap", G); onSSE("heartbeat", H)
    (nothing)
#2 ← heartbeat {"build":"b1","seq":10}
    t=0 handler H({"build":"b1","seq":10}, <event>)
#2 ← heartbeat {"build":"b1","seq":12}
    t=0 handler G(null, null)
    t=0 handler H({"build":"b1","seq":12}, <event>)
#2 ← heartbeat {"build":"b1"}  (no seq: Core)
    t=0 handler H({"build":"b1"}, <event>)
onSSE("build-changed", BC), BC showing notice.js's "build" banner
    (nothing)
#2 ← heartbeat {"build":"b2","seq":12}  (a new build)
    t=0 handler BC({"build":"b2","seq":12}, <event>)
    t=0 handler H({"build":"b2","seq":12}, <event>)
    t=0 refresh banner shown
    the banner:
      div class="notice-banner notice-banner--info" role="status" data-banner="build"
        span class="notice-text"
          "A new version is available."
        button class="notice-action" type="button" listens=click
          "Refresh"
        button class="notice-dismiss" type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" listens=click
          "×"
the banner again while it is shown
    t=0 banners in the DOM: 1
click Dismiss
    t=0 refresh banner gone
#2 ← connected {"build":"b2"}  (the new build again, after Dismiss)
    t=0 handler BC({"build":"b2"}, <event>)
    t=0 handler C({"build":"b2"}, <event>)
    t=0 refresh banner shown
click Refresh
    t=0 location.reload()

## watchdog
setSSEWatchdog(5000) on the open #9, then 6 s with no frame
    (nothing)
#9 ← heartbeat {"build":"b1"} (re-arms), then 4.9 s, a frame, 4.9 s
    t=42000 handler H({"build":"b1"}, <event>)
    t=46900 handler B({"id":9}, <event>)
then 0.2 s more (5.1 s since the last frame)
    t=51900 close #9
    t=51900 handler D(null, null)
    t=53900 open #10 /events?topics=bins%2Corder-update
    = #10 opened 2000 ms after #9 closed
as #10 opens (its watchdog armed): setSSEWatchdog(0), #10 ← connected {"build":"b1"}, then 60 s with no frame
    t=53900 handler C({"build":"b1"}, <event>)

## reload on build
setSSEReloadOnBuild(true); #10 ← connected {"build":"b3"}
    t=113900 location.reload()
    t=113900 handler C({"build":"b3"}, <event>)
#10 ← heartbeat {"build":"b3"}
    t=113900 location.reload()
    t=113900 handler H({"build":"b3"}, <event>)
#10 ← heartbeat {"build":"b1"}
    t=113900 handler H({"build":"b1"}, <event>)

## close
#10 error, then closeSSEBus() before the reconnect fires
    t=113900 close #10
    t=113900 handler D(null, null)
    = no new stream within 70000 ms
onSSE("later", F) after closeSSEBus()
    (nothing)

## the URL
a second page: only stream frames subscribed: onSSE("connected", C)
    (nothing)
a second page: only the bus's own frames (connected, disconnected, heartbeat, stream-gap, build-changed), then 60 s
    t=60000 streams opened: 0
a second page: onSSE("build-changed", BC) at import (a hub), then a page module, a microtask later, onSSE("a")
    t=0 streams opened before the page: 0
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=a
a second page: onSSE("a") and onSSE("connected"), stream up, a's subscription off, then the stream errors and 60 s pass
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=a
    t=0 close #1
a second page: onSSE("a"), stream up, its subscription off, the stream errors, then onSSE("b")
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=a
    t=0 close #1
    t=60000 open #2 /events?topics=b
a second page: setSSEQuery({station:7, a:"x y"}) then onSSE("b"), onSSE("a")
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=a%2Cb&a=x%20y&station=7
a second page: onSSE("a"), stream up, then setSSEQuery({station:7}) and onSSE("b")
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=a
    t=0 close #1
    t=0 open #2 /events?topics=a%2Cb&station=7

    t=0 close #1

    t=0 close #1

    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=a
